notice: Manual call recipes, not an execution or placeholder-substitution engine. Use a dedicated test scene/actors. Replace IDs and currency abbreviations using real results; repeat reads for every affected actor.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_currency_config
calls.expect: Use the returned registered abbreviations and configured system paths; gp/sp below are examples.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_items
calls.expect: Read exact embedded item IDs and module quantities.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_currencies
calls.expect: Read both zero and nonzero configured balances, including secondaries.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_item_categories
calls.expect: Read localized categories for the active system.

calls.name: module_item-piles_inspect_item
calls.expect: Inspect quantity, cost, stacking and invalid-filter reason.

calls.name: module_item-piles_create_pile
calls.expect: Save result.actor_uuid as CHEST_EFFECTIVE and result.token_uuid as CHEST. base_actor_uuid is not the unlinked token inventory.

calls.name: module_item-piles_add_items
calls.expect: Four units are added; inspect the destination inventory for its actual embedded item ID.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_items
calls.expect: Save the destination potion ID as CHEST_POTION_ID; added items can merge with existing stacks.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_pile
calls.expect: Check container type, flags and inventory-empty state.

calls.name: module_item-piles_set_container_state
calls.expect: Verify closed=true and locked=true.

calls.name: module_item-piles_set_container_state
calls.expect: Verify closed=false and locked=false.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_items
calls.expect: One unit moves. Read both actors; interaction_id does not deduplicate.

calls.name: module_item-piles_remove_items
calls.expect: Remove an explicitly selected test unit; inspect the final quantity.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_all_items
calls.expect: Transfer eligible non-currency items. Currency is handled separately.

calls.name: module_item-piles_create_pile
calls.expect: Save effective actor_uuid and token_uuid. Configure prices/tables in Item Piles UI where needed.

calls.name: module_item-piles_add_items
calls.expect: Seed finite stock, then read the merchant to identify MERCHANT_POTION_ID.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_items
calls.expect: Save the actual potion UUID as MERCHANT_POTION_UUID and its ID as MERCHANT_POTION_ID.

calls.name: module_item-piles_add_currencies
calls.expect: Add a known test balance using a denomination from currency_configuration.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_merchant_modifiers
calls.expect: Read effective merchant multipliers for this customer.

calls.name: module_item-piles_update_merchant_modifiers
calls.expect: Verify the observed Actor-specific modifiers.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_item_prices
calls.expect: Inspect payment_index, requested_units, units_per_purchase and affordability before trading.

calls.name: module_item-piles_trade_items
calls.expect: Execute one purchase line; quantity counts purchases. Read both inventories and both currency balances afterwards.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_currencies
calls.expect: Inspect observed merchant balances; infiniteCurrencies changes expected stock/payment behavior.

calls.name: module_item-piles_refresh_merchant_inventory
calls.expect: Populate from tables configured in the merchant UI, retaining existing stock. This example is optional if no tables are configured.

calls.name: module_item-piles_create_pile
calls.expect: Save effective actor_uuid/token_uuid. Access flags configure the player UI; MCP writes still require a GM.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_vault_grid
calls.expect: Read actual free cells, occupied placements and the separate upstream free-space estimate.

calls.name: module_item-piles_check_vault_fit
calls.expect: Check whether one item can merge or occupy a new position; space is not reserved.

calls.name: module_item-piles_plan_vault_fit
calls.expect: Preview only; nonstackable quantities expand to separate placements.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_items
calls.expect: Move two units using Item Piles' own inventory and vault behavior.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_items
calls.expect: Find the actual destination ID VAULT_POTION_ID before withdrawal.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_items
calls.expect: Withdraw one unit, then re-read both inventories and the vault grid.

calls.name: module_item-piles_create_pile
calls.expect: Save effective actor_uuid/token_uuid. Explicit sharing flags prevent the inspected split-currency defect.

calls.name: module_item-piles_roll_item_table
calls.expect: Item deltas confirm the item response only. Text results may add currency; read the pile balances afterwards.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_items
calls.expect: Inspect the rolled loot before splitting.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_currencies
calls.expect: Inspect any currency side effects from table results.

calls.name: module_item-piles_update_pile
calls.expect: Verify both item sharing and currency sharing before invoking split.

calls.name: module_item-piles_split_pile
calls.expect: Verify deltas for exactly both recipients. Rounding/sharing may leave a remainder; read all three actors.

calls.name: module_item-piles_calculate_currencies
calls.expect: Compute a primary-currency amount using the configured exchange rates. No state changes.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_payment_data
calls.expect: Inspect canBuy and change for a primary-currency payment snapshot.

calls.name: module_item-piles_update_currencies
calls.expect: Set an attribute-backed test balance. Item-backed denominations are rejected by this tool.

calls.name: module_item-piles_remove_currencies
calls.expect: Remove a primary-currency amount; read the observed balance.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_currencies
calls.expect: Transfer primary currency; read both balances after the operation.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_all_currencies
calls.expect: Transfer all configured currencies, including secondaries, through the upstream all-currency method.

calls.name: module_item-piles_set_attributes
calls.expect: Replace the path with a valid numeric system field. Sets the explicit amount.

calls.name: module_item-piles_add_attributes
calls.expect: Add a positive amount to the chosen numeric system field.

calls.name: module_item-piles_remove_attributes
calls.expect: Remove a positive amount without exceeding the observed source balance.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_attributes
calls.expect: Transfer an explicit safe system attribute between distinct actors.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_all_attributes
calls.expect: Transfer configured attribute-currency balances that exist on both actors; uses the public transferAttributes workaround.

calls.name: module_item-piles_transfer_everything
calls.expect: Transfer all eligible items/currencies. Upstream may delete an emptied source token according to its settings.

calls.name: module_item-piles_combine_piles
calls.expect: Combine enabled distinct source piles. Residual eligible balances make the outcome uncertain; no atomic rollback is promised.

calls.name: module_item-piles_convert_tokens
calls.expect: Enable Item Piles on an existing token; linked tokens also affect their shared Actor.

calls.name: module_item-piles_revert_tokens
calls.expect: Disable Item Piles while retaining Actor and inventory; linked Actor effects are verified.

calls.name: module_item-piles_delete_pile
calls.expect: Remove only the selected pile token. The base Actor is not deleted.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_items
calls.expect: Inspect the second loot recipient after splitting.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_currencies
calls.expect: Inspect the second loot recipient's currency balances.

calls.name: module_item-piles_get_currencies
calls.expect: Inspect monetary vault effects separately from inventory and grid results.

workflows.title: Create, fill and use a treasure chest
Prepare a merchant and buy one item line
Plan, deposit and withdraw vault inventory
